resources.string: Where do you want to stream?
Choose a platform, then select the destination for this match.
Copy the server and key from your platform. You can also paste a complete RTMP/RTMPS URL. The public video link is not a streaming address.
The key is reusable. Before streaming, check the event and Public visibility in YouTube Studio.
Connect Facebook and choose your account or a managed Page. No live broadcast is created during selection.
Creating the match prepares a public Facebook live broadcast for this destination. Start streaming from the match to send video.
Destination selected. After creating the match, start streaming and check publication on the platform.
Saved YouTube list: availability has not been verified. Refresh before using a changed or reset key.
Saved destination: check that its stream key is still valid. The link to an earlier live event is not reused.
No streams found. Enable live streaming and prepare a stream in YouTube Studio, then retry or change account.
Connection cancelled. Connect again to choose a destination.
Session expired. Reconnect Facebook; if it persists, sign in to Spike Stream again.
Facebook has not granted the required permissions. Reconnect and allow access to your Pages, or use a manual RTMP address from Live Producer.
Facebook destination unavailable. Choose another account or Page, or check eligibility in Live Producer.
Unable to complete the request. Check your connection and retry.
